title.narrative: Joint Executive Program of the Project for Prevention and Response to Outbreaks of Measles and Polio in High-Risk Countries in the Eastern Mediterranean Region - Republic of Somalia

description.narrative: - Expanding the vaccination coverage to eliminate polio and measles 2- Supporting the health sector in the Republic of Somalia by providing medical devices that can be used for many years 3- Supporting cold chains with electrical generators and solar-powered equipment, which achieves sustainability 4- Capacity building through training Somalis rely on renewable and alternative energy as a solution to the continuing problems of electricity generation
Eliminating the polio and measles epidemic and supporting the health sector with medical and laboratory equipment for 2,500,000 beneficiaries

The project is based on a set of different activities to defeat the polio and measles epidemics in Somalia by securing the needs of cold chains, including electric generators and serum containers, in addition to some laboratory equipment and medical and laboratory consumables, in addition to the operating budget for vaccination campaigns, as well as securing vaccines and medical consumables accompanying the campaigns. Vaccination, as well as providing refrigerators and solar-powered containers
